summary: The change adds the missing keygen.ubq.fi custom-domain route to the keygen-ubq-fi Worker and updates the hosting documentation to match. No actionable defect was found.

evidence: wrangler.toml line 4 binds the keygen-ubq-fi Worker to keygen.ubq.fi as a custom domain, addressing the reported 404 caused by the missing route.
The existing static assets configuration still serves ./static with single-page-application fallback, so the key generator UI is available through the newly bound domain.
README lines 28-29 now accurately document that the Worker is bound to the keygen.ubq.fi custom domain with single-page fallback.
